chartCaption.message: Avg daily peak $1% used · $2 days with data

chatgptNoEndpoint.message: No live meter for this plan — Zero Grok shows a number once ChatGPT displays a limit. Turn on local estimates in Options if you want a rough count.

claudeNoData.message: Could not read usage yet — try Refresh after a chat.

claudeNoOrg.message: No organization found — open claude.ai once while signed in.

clearConfirm.message: Delete all locally stored usage history?

cmdToggleCan.message: Show or hide the floating can

cmdTogglePanel.message: Open the usage panel on the current AI site

dataHint.message: Usage history (up to 31 days) is stored only on this device.

estimateCountOnly.message: No public cap — showing your local message count only.

estimateNote.message: Local estimate from messages you sent in this browser — not official.

estimateRough.message: Rough guess: ~$1 msgs on $2 plan. Not official.

extDescription.message: Floating usage meter for Grok, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and more: remaining %, reset countdown, alerts and history. All data stays in your browser.

forecastEta.message: At this pace you'll hit zero ~$1

forecastLasts.message: At this pace it lasts until the reset

geminiNoData.message: Open gemini.google.com/usage once while signed in — the reading is then shared with your other Gemini tabs.

genericNoData.message: $1 doesn't publish usage limits. Zero Grok counts the messages you send here (local estimate) and flags limit banners.

grokHeuristicNote.message: Decoded from a binary billing response without a documented field — treat as an estimate.

hiddenSitesEmpty.message: None. Use “Hide on this site” in the can’s panel.

needsUpdateLong.message: $1 tracking needs an update — the site changed and Zero Grok can't read usage right now. Numbers are hidden instead of guessing.

notifResetBody.message: $1 limit has reset. The can is full again.

onbF1.message: Live remaining % on a floating soda can, with a reset countdown

onbF2.message: Grok, Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini built in — Perplexity, DeepSeek, Le Chat, Copilot and Meta AI optional

onbF3.message: Every number is labelled: site usage API, read from page, or estimate

onbF4.message: Alerts at your thresholds, quiet hours, and a hint when another AI has room

onbF5.message: Everything stays in your browser — no servers, no analytics

onbPermSkipped.message: Optional sites were not enabled because access was not granted. You can turn them on later in Options.

onbSaved.message: Saved! Open any supported AI site to see your can.

onbSetupHint.message: Your plan sets sensible defaults (for example, rough caps used only when a site shows no numbers). Optional sites will ask for access.

onbTagline.message: Watch your AI usage drain like a soda can. Never get rate-limited by surprise.

onbTip.message: Open a supported site while signed in and the can appears. Click it for details, drag it to any corner, or press Alt+Shift+U. For Gemini, open gemini.google.com/usage once.

onbUpdates.message: I installed the ZIP — tell me when a new version is on GitHub

optAutoUpdate.message: Check GitHub for new versions every 6 hours (for ZIP / “Load unpacked” installs — store installs update automatically)

optEstimate.message: Local message estimate for Grok / Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini when no live number exists (labelled, not official)

optNotifyReset.message: Notify me when a limit resets

optReduceMotion.message: Reduce motion (no bubbles or pop animations)

optRemoteSelectors.message: Download selector fixes (a small data-only JSON file from GitHub, never code)

optSound.message: Can-pop sound on first use and after a refill

optSuggest.message: Suggest another AI with room left when one runs low

optionsDesc.message: Everything stays in your browser. Settings sync through your browser profile if sync is on.

popupEmpty.message: Open Grok, Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini while signed in — numbers appear after the first read.

popupSubtitle.message: All AI usage at a glance

positionHint.message: Drag the can anywhere — drop it near a corner to snap. Hover it and press – to shrink it to a dot.

privacyNote.message: All data stays in your browser. No servers, no analytics.

providersHint.message: Built-in sites are always allowed. Extra sites ask for permission only when you turn them on.

shareFooter.message: Zero Grok · data stays in my browser

shortcutsHint.message: Alt+Shift+U opens the usage panel. Alt+U shows or hides the can.

shortcutsManual.message: Open your browser’s extension shortcut settings

statusNoData.message: No reading yet — use the site normally, then Refresh.
